title: DWG spec-diff and independent-route reconciliation
mode: Primary-source specification and repository documentation review with local source/test inventory; no peer runtime
scope: Compare the official ODA DWG specification used by this repository with the LibreDWG-maintained ODA 5.4.2 diff without treating peer text as normative authority.
Cross-check concrete R2004 page-header offsets against local reader and generated test sources.
Refine AC1032 implementation readiness using the specification's explicit R2018 deltas and existing sample-trace rules.
Reconcile independent peer and consumer routes by direction, version, lineage, and evidence type.

sources.project: Open Design Alliance Open Design Specification v5.4.1
sources.observed: The official PDF documents the R13 C2/C3 boundary, R2004 data-page checksum fields at offsets 0x18 and 0x1C with the unknown word at 0x14, and explicit R2018 header/AuxHeader/object deltas including three trailing zero int16 fields in the auxiliary file header.
sources.limits: Specification review is not an AC1032 sample trace or native interoperability run. The PDF remains the project's normative DWG byte-layout reference.

sources.revision: Mutable master path reviewed 2026-10-20; the patch header identifies ODA 5.4.1 as its base.
sources.observed: The peer-maintained diff revises LibreDWG's copy of the ODA text and includes a page-header checksum ordering that agrees with official ODA v5.4.1 §4.6.
sources.limits: It is not an ODA-issued v5.4.2 specification and does not establish that ODA accepted every peer revision. No code, sample, or runtime result was derived from the diff.

sources.observed: The R2004 page parser reads the unknown field at 0x14, header checksum at 0x18, and data checksum at 0x1C; generated reader-matrix helpers construct this page layout.
sources.limits: Static source/test inventory only; no test was run and no external DWG was used.

sources.observed: The current AC1032 class follows the documented thin pass-through/inheritance path; the explicit ODA R2018 delta list can make the existing sample-driven audit more concrete.
sources.limits: No AC1032 sample was traced in this research pass. The source-level pass-through is not evidence that AC1032 support is qualified.

sources.project: Open-source peer and consumer route documentation
sources.observed: The reviewed routes differ by parser lineage, format direction, projection, version matrix, and consumer/importer behavior. GDAL CAD is a narrow read-only libopencad projection; FreeCAD's DWG route composes an external converter and selected DXF importer; other peers remain subject to the exact version/direction and lineage controls already in the plan.
sources.limits: Documentation establishes candidate route scope, not execution, per-object completeness, or semantic correctness.

existingOwnersRefined: AC1032/R2018 reader and writer sample-trace readiness: explicit HEADER, AuxHeader, and named object-family deltas remain separated.
R2004 page parser: preserve existing ODA-confirmed page-header/checksum offsets and generated controls.
Peer eligibility: bind immutable route, direction, target version, implementation lineage, diagnostics, and per-object disposition.

planChanges: Added a source-backed distinction between official ODA v5.4.1 authority and the LibreDWG-maintained ODA 5.4.2 diff.
Cross-checked local R2004 page-header field offsets and retained the existing test owner without adding duplicate tests.
Made the existing AC1032 implementation item more ready by listing ODA-defined R2018 HEADER, AuxHeader, and object-family deltas separately.
Preserved local fixture restrictions, reduced per-slice validation, self-unblocking, and all six external-only deferred statuses.
limitations: LibreDWG patch and repository documentation are mutable peer sources, not normative ODA material.
No AC1032 source drawing was traced and no test was executed.
No peer executable, native CAD application, geometry kernel, external sample, or full suite was used.
Existing plan route restrictions were cross-checked; this pass did not audit every peer source file or every local implementation path.
